title: Vault Collision
description: A woman in a blue and yellow jumpsuit with glowing green energy around her collides with a man in a dark suit inside a destroyed vault. Papers, paintings, and debris fly through the air as a massive circular vault door cracks behind them under dramatic spotlight illumination.
prompt: A dynamic action scene inside a destroyed vault where a woman wearing a blue and yellow jumpsuit surrounded by glowing green energy is forcefully colliding with a man in a dark suit. The massive circular steel vault door is cracking behind them. Papers, framed paintings, and debris are flying through the air. Dramatic spotlight from above illuminates the chaos while red emergency lights glow in the background. Cinematic composition with rich details and dramatic lighting.
